scripts.sync-keys-claimshield: rm -rf pkgs/app/public/managed/claimshield && mkdir -p pkgs/app/public/managed/claimshield && cp -Rf pkgs/contract/src/managed/claimshield/keys pkgs/app/public/managed/claimshield/ && cp -Rf pkgs/contract/src/managed/claimshield/zkir pkgs/app/public/managed/claimshield/
scripts.build: bun run --cwd pkgs/contract build && bun run sync-keys-claimshield && bun run --cwd pkgs/shared build && bun run --cwd pkgs/cli build && bun run --cwd pkgs/app build
scripts.build:app: bun run --cwd pkgs/contract build && bun run sync-keys-claimshield && bun run --cwd pkgs/shared build && bun run --cwd pkgs/app build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd pkgs/shared build && bun run --cwd pkgs/app build && bun run --cwd pkgs/cli typecheck && bun run --cwd pkgs/contract build
